units.source_text: 为了上述种种事情，入山修行的朱雀院的五十庆寿，延期到秋天举行。

en.t: Because of all these circumstances, the celebration of the cloistered Suzaku Emperor's fiftieth birthday was postponed until autumn.

units.source_text: 但八月是夕雾大将的生母葵夫人的忌月，夕雾未便出席指挥乐队；

en.t: But August was the memorial month for Lady Aoi, the birth mother of General Yugiri, so it was not convenient for Yugiri to attend and direct the musicians;

units.source_text: 九月又是朱雀院的母亲弘徽殿太后的忌月，庆寿只得定在十月。

en.t: September, too, was the memorial month for Suzaku's mother, the Empress Dowager Kokiden, so the celebration had to be set for October.

units.source_text: 但到了十月，三公主病重起来，又延迟了几天。

en.t: But when October came, the Third Princess became seriously ill, and it was delayed for several more days.

units.source_text: 柏木卫门督的夫人落叶公主，于十月来到朱雀院邸宅贺寿。

en.t: Princess Ochiba, the wife of Kashiwagi, Captain of the Gate Guards, came in October to Suzaku's residence to offer birthday congratulations.

units.source_text: 她的公爹前太政大臣亲自备办贺礼，隆重而又周到，其仪式尽善尽美。

en.t: Her father-in-law, the former Grand Minister, personally prepared the gifts, and the ceremony was grand, thoughtful, and flawless in every detail.

units.source_text: 柏木乘此机会告个奋勇，也来贺寿。

en.t: Kashiwagi took this opportunity to volunteer himself and came to offer his congratulations as well.

units.source_text: 然而身心还未复健，一直萎靡不振，像个病人。

en.t: Yet his body and spirit had not recovered, and he remained listless and weak, like a sick man.

units.source_text: 三公主也局促不安，负疚在心，日夜悲叹。

en.t: The Third Princess, too, was restless and uneasy, burdened by guilt, and lamented day and night.

units.source_text: 怀胎月份多了，身体不胜痛苦。

en.t: As her pregnancy advanced, her body became unable to bear the suffering.

units.source_text: 源氏虽然怀着不快之感，但看到这个娇小玲珑而弱不禁风的人身患病苦，

en.t: Although Genji still harbored resentment, when he saw this small, delicate, frail woman suffering from illness,

units.source_text: 亦觉十分可怜，不知将有什么变化，左思右想，十分忧闷。

en.t: he also felt deeply sorry for her, and, not knowing what might happen, worried over it again and again in great distress.

units.source_text: 这一年做了种种法事，忙忙碌碌地过去了。

en.t: That year passed busily, filled with all sorts of Buddhist memorial rites.

units.source_text: 朱雀院闻知三公主怀孕，不胜挂念。

en.t: When Suzaku heard that the Third Princess was pregnant, he was exceedingly anxious.

units.source_text: 曾有人奏闻：“源氏大人近几月来常常住在外面，几乎绝不回家宿夜。”

en.t: Someone had once reported to him, "Lord Genji has often been staying away from home in recent months and almost never returns to spend the night."

units.source_text: 因此他很怀疑：公主怎么会有喜呢？

en.t: Because of this, he was deeply suspicious: how could the princess be with child?

units.source_text: 心中纳闷，便觉世间男女问题实甚可恨。

en.t: Troubled at heart, he felt that matters between men and women in this world were truly hateful.

units.source_text: 他听说紫夫人患病期间源氏为了照料病人，久不来三公主处，心中已经感觉不快。

en.t: He had already been displeased when he heard that, during Lady Murasaki's illness, Genji had stayed away from the Third Princess for a long time in order to care for the patient.

units.source_text: 后来又闻紫夫人病愈之后，源氏还是疏远三公主，

en.t: Later, he also heard that even after Lady Murasaki recovered, Genji still kept his distance from the Third Princess,

units.source_text: 他便疑心：“难道源氏外宿期间，三公主犯了过失？

en.t: and he began to suspect, "Could the Third Princess have committed some fault while Genji was staying away?

units.source_text: 她自己不懂得这些事，只怕有些品性不良的侍女为非作歹，出了什么事情。

en.t: She herself understands nothing of such matters, so perhaps some ill-natured lady-in-waiting did something improper and caused an incident.

units.source_text: 在宫廷中，男女互相通信，本是风雅之事，

en.t: At court, the exchange of letters between men and women is in itself an elegant thing,

units.source_text: 但有时也会发生荒唐的事故，其例时有所闻。”

en.t: but sometimes absurd mishaps occur, and one hears of such examples from time to time."

units.source_text: 他竟如此猜想。

en.t: Such were the thoughts he actually entertained.

units.source_text: 世俗琐事，朱雀院均已抛舍，惟父女之爱，犹自未能忘怀，

en.t: Suzaku had cast aside all trivial worldly concerns, yet he still could not forget a father's love for his daughter,

units.source_text: 于是写了一封详细的信给三公主。

en.t: and so he wrote a detailed letter to the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 信送到时，正好源氏在六条院，便阅读了。

en.t: When the letter arrived, Genji happened to be at Rokujo-in, and he read it.

units.source_text: 但见其中有云：“只因无甚要事，所以久不通问。

en.t: In it he found these words: "Because there was no particular matter of importance, I have long failed to write and inquire after you.

units.source_text: 音信暌隔，日月推迁，使我不胜悬念。

en.t: As our messages have been cut off and the days and months have passed, I have become unbearably anxious.

units.source_text: 汝近身患疾苦，我闻知详情以后，诵经念佛之余，时深挂念，不知近日如何。

en.t: Since hearing in detail that you have lately been suffering from illness, I have worried deeply for you even between sutra recitations and prayers; I wonder how you are these days.

units.source_text: 人生于世，即使寂寞寡欢，或遭意外之变，亦应耐心忍受。

en.t: While living in this world, even if one is lonely and joyless or meets with unexpected misfortune, one should endure patiently.

units.source_text: 轻信人言，自以为是，而怀恨于人，实乃下品行为。”

en.t: To believe others' words too readily, think oneself in the right, and bear resentment toward another is truly a base way to behave."

units.source_text: 诸如此类，都是教训之言。

en.t: All the rest was of the same kind, words of admonition.

units.source_text: 源氏看了，深为同情。

en.t: When Genji read it, he felt deep sympathy.

units.source_text: 独自寻思：“上皇当然不曾知道那件秘密的祸事，

en.t: He thought to himself, "The Retired Emperor naturally knows nothing of that secret calamity,

units.source_text: 因此认为罪在于我，一味怨我无情。”

en.t: and so he believes the fault lies with me and simply resents me for being heartless."

units.source_text: 对三公主说：“你写回信时将如何说法呢？

en.t: He said to the Third Princess, "What will you say when you write your reply?

units.source_text: 如此伤心的信，我看了也很痛苦！

en.t: Even I found such a sorrowful letter painful to read.

units.source_text: 我虽知道你有意想不到之事，但并没有使外人觉察到我对你有所怠慢啊。

en.t: Although I know that something unexpected has happened to you, I have not let outsiders notice any neglect of you on my part.

units.source_text: 不知是谁告诉你父亲的。”

en.t: I do not know who told your father."

units.source_text: 三公主羞耻不堪，背转身去，神情非常可怜。

en.t: The Third Princess, unable to bear her shame, turned her back, and her expression was deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: 她面庞清瘦，神思恍惚，姿态反而更加优雅妩媚了。

en.t: Her face had grown thin and her mind seemed dazed, yet her bearing had become all the more graceful and beautiful.
